parameters{

	CAERPTS_DB as string (),
	CAERPTS_PWD as string (),
	CAERPTS_USER as string (),
	MOBILE_DATASOURCE as string (),
	MOBILE_DB as string (),
	MOBILE_PWD as string (),
	MOBILE_USER as string (),
	OLTP_DATASOURCE as string (),
	OLTP_DB as string (),
	OLTP_PWD as string (),
	OLTP_USER as string (),
	v_Archive as string (),
	v_ExcelSQL as string (),
	v_FileExists as string (),
	v_IsArchive as integer (),
	v_MonthDecrement as integer (),
	v_SourceID as integer (),
	v_SRCFile as string (),
	v_SRCFileArchive as string (),
	v_SRCFileName as string (),
	v_SRCFilePath as string (),
	v_SRCFolder as string ()
}

source(output(
		CID as integer,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		ATTEMPT as short,
		{501886} as string,
		{536454} as string,
		{536463} as string,
		{536468} as string,
		{536455} as string,
		{536464} as string,
		{536469} as string,
		{536456} as string,
		{536465} as string,
		{536470} as string,
		{536458} as string,
		{536467} as string,
		{536472} as string,
		FORM_ID as string,
		SOURCE as string,
		USER_ID as string,
		UPDATE_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CID,SUBSCRIBER_ID,ATTEMPT,\'500831\' AS FORM_ID, \'0\' AS SOURCE, \'2597\' As USER_ID, UPDATE_DATE, \'2\' as \'501886\', cast(month(Convert(varchar(10),[536454],101)) as varchar(2)) + \'/\' +cast(day(Convert(varchar(10),[536454],101)) as varchar(2)) + \'/\' +cast(year(Convert(varchar(10),[536454],101)) as varchar(4)) [536454], cast(month(Convert(varchar(10),[536463],101)) as varchar(2)) + \'/\' +cast(day(Convert(varchar(10),[536463],101)) as varchar(2)) + \'/\' +cast(year(Convert(varchar(10),[536463],101)) as varchar(4)) [536463], cast(month(Convert(varchar(10),[536468],101)) as varchar(2)) + \'/\' +cast(day(Convert(varchar(10),[536468],101)) as varchar(2)) + \'/\' +cast(year(Convert(varchar(10),[536468],101)) as varchar(4)) [536468], CASE WHEN  [536454]  IS NOT NULL THEN  \'1\'  END \'536455\', CASE WHEN  [536463] IS NOT NULL THEN  \'1\'  END \'536464\', CASE WHEN  [536468] IS NOT NULL THEN  \'1\'  END \'536469\', CASE WHEN  [536454] IS NOT NULL THEN  \'2\'  END \'536456\', CASE WHEN  [536463] IS NOT NULL THEN  \'2\'  END \'536465\', CASE WHEN  [536468] IS NOT NULL THEN  \'2\'  END \'536470\', CASE WHEN  [536454] IS NOT NULL THEN  LTRIM(LEFT(RIGHT(convert(VARCHAR, [536454], 100), 8), 6) +\' \' +RIGHT(convert(VARCHAR, [536454], 100), 2)) END \'536458\', CASE WHEN  [536463] IS NOT NULL THEN  LTRIM(LEFT(RIGHT(convert(VARCHAR, [536463], 100), 8), 6) +\' \' +RIGHT(convert(VARCHAR, [536463], 100), 2)) END \'536467\', CASE WHEN  [536468] IS NOT NULL THEN  LTRIM(LEFT(RIGHT(convert(VARCHAR, [536468], 100), 8), 6) +\' \' +RIGHT(convert(VARCHAR, [536468], 100), 2)) END \'536472\' FROM (SELECT CID,SUBSCRIBER_ID, CONCEPT,ATTEMPT_DATE ,ATTEMPT, UPDATE_DATE     FROM (SELECT MHA.CID,MHA.SUBSCRIBER_ID, 			CASE WHEN ATTEMPT=1 THEN 536454 WHEN ATTEMPT=2 THEN 536463 WHEN ATTEMPT=3 THEN 536468 END AS CONCEPT , 			  			ATTEMPT_DATE, 			ATTEMPT, 			DATEADD(MINUTE,TIMEADD,MHA.UPDATE_DATE) UPDATE_DATE,STATUS,   			CASE WHEN ATTEMPT=1 THEN 536455 WHEN ATTEMPT=2 THEN 536464 WHEN ATTEMPT=3 THEN 536469 END AS [Phone Call], 			CASE WHEN ATTEMPT=1 THEN 536456 WHEN ATTEMPT=2 THEN 536465 WHEN ATTEMPT=3 THEN 536470 END AS  Unsuccessful FROM [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS] MHA WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSCRIBER_ID FROM [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS_STAGE] WITH (NOLOCK)) IOS ON MHA.SUBSCRIBER_ID=IOS.SUBSCRIBER_ID  WHERE STATUS IS NULL )x) AS SourceTable PIVOT ( MAX(ATTEMPT_DATE) FOR CONCEPT IN ([536454], [536463], [536468]) ) AS PivotTable ORDER BY CID,UPDATE_DATE,ATTEMPT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCMAHRACALLATTEMPTS
SRCMAHRACALLATTEMPTS derive({Copy of 536469} = toString({536469}),
		{Copy of 536455} = toString({536455}),
		{Copy of 536467} = toString({536467}),
		{Copy of 501886} = toString({501886}),
		{Copy of 536468} = toString({536468}),
		{Copy of 536464} = toString({536464}),
		{Copy of 536472} = toString({536472}),
		{Copy of 536463} = toString({536463}),
		{Copy of 536456} = toString({536456}),
		{Copy of 536458} = toString({536458}),
		{Copy of 536465} = toString({536465}),
		{Copy of 536470} = toString({536470}),
		{Copy of 536454} = toString({536454})) ~> DCCONCEPTS
DCCONCEPTS unpivot(output(
		CONCEPT_ID as string,
		CONCEPT_VALUE as string
	),
	ungroupBy(ATTEMPT,
		UPDATE_DATE,
		USER_ID,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		SOURCE,
		FORM_ID,
		CID
	),
	lateral: false,
	ignoreNullPivots: false) ~> Unpivot
Unpivot derive(TRANSFER_STATUS = 'P',
		SOURCE = $v_SourceID) ~> DERSTATUS
DERSTATUS derive(DC_CONCEPT_VALUE = toString(CONCEPT_VALUE),
		DC_CONCEPT_ID = toInteger(CONCEPT_ID),
		DC_TRANSFER_STATUS = toString(TRANSFER_STATUS)) ~> DCCONCEPTIDSTATUS
DCCONCEPTIDSTATUS aggregate(groupBy(CID,FORM_ID,UPDATE_DATE,USER_ID,DC_TRANSFER_STATUS,DC_CONCEPT_ID,DC_CONCEPT_VALUE,SOURCE),
	{DER_STATUS.SOURCE} = last(SOURCE)) ~> Aggregate
Aggregate sink(input(
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		UPDATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SOURCE as integer,
		USER_ID as integer,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string,
		CONCEPT_VALUE as string,
		FORM_ID as integer,
		CID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CONCEPT_ID = DC_CONCEPT_ID,
		UPDATE_DATE,
		SOURCE = {DER_STATUS.SOURCE},
		USER_ID,
		TRANSFER_STATUS = DC_TRANSFER_STATUS,
		CONCEPT_VALUE = DC_CONCEPT_VALUE,
		FORM_ID,
		CID)) ~> DSTCPMWBFORM
